item.description:
Toucan 1.0.4

  • Fewer Settings pages. Touch ID and Auto-lock are now in Settings › General, and Scans & OCR is in Settings › Global rules, under File formats.
  • Find & replace and Reveal share one page, Settings › Swap & reveal. Each keeps its own switch, and their permissions are listed together at the end.
  • A shorter menu. Show Project in Finder is now Active Project Folders, with Recordings at the end. Find & Replace, Drop Bar and Check for Updates… have left the menu: switch them on in Settings › Swap & reveal, Settings › General and Settings › About.
  • The Settings sidebar and the Drop bar show a project by its name alone. Point at a project in the sidebar to see its code. The menu still shows the name and code.

Toucan 1.0.3

  • Shorter Settings pages: rows that only explained how something works are gone, described instead in a new help page, What Toucan always does, in Settings › About.
  • The Drop bar shows only the padlock and Toucan’s icon until you point at it, so a client’s name isn’t on screen when you share it. Dragging a file near it still shows which project it goes to.
  • The Drop bar now follows the theme in Settings › General, and projects always show by name and code.
  • File formats are now in Settings › Global rules, with their switches under Edit…. Long lists there show five at a time.
  • The Paste and Tokenise window is gone. Option-Shift-A and Option-Shift-R still tokenise and restore the clipboard.
  • Team members: an admin shows as on every project, and a single Mac on one line.

Toucan 1.0.2

  • A simpler Settings sidebar: the search box is gone (click the list and type a project’s code to jump to it), and Recording & transcription is now called Recording.
  • Help is now part of Settings › About, with the setup guide and the help pages above updates and what’s new.
  • Archived projects open from the archive button beside New project at the top of the sidebar, so the sidebar lists your live projects only.
